blocks.text: Diagnostics for Digital Experience (ZDX) can provide deeper granularity into process-level information for a user. During a session, information is collected every minute for the Web probe and Cloud Path probe, as well as device statistics.

blocks.item: You're running the minimum required versions of Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module. To learn more, see Supported Versions & Feature Compatibility.
Your Digital Experience subscription level supports Diagnostics. To learn more, see Ranges and Limitations.
Your admin role is configured for Diagnostics. To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.

blocks.text: If you still can't view the Diagnostics details in the Zscaler Admin Console, contact your ZDX admin to check your permissions.

You can start a session to analyze issues that a user, device, or application is facing. You can choose to run the session to monitor issues from 5 minutes to 60 minutes. You can view session information on the Diagnostics page and also export it as a PDF file for reference and information sharing.
Diagnostics provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Configure sessions to capture granular details. For example, Packet Capture (PCAP) information, device statistics, or application information.
Analyze, evaluate, and troubleshoot issues for a user, device, or application.
Share the results and information of the session for reference by exporting it to a PDF file.

blocks.text: On the Diagnostics page (Digital Experience > Reports > Diagnostics), you can do the following:

blocks.item: To start a session, an active probe is required on the device. The active probe must run for a minimum duration of 30 minutes. To learn more, see Configuring a Probe.
View the supported Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module versions.
View information on sessions in the In Progress table.
View PCAP information and copy specific PCAP information (e.g., Packet Capture Filter, Network Interface) to your clipboard.
Copy the details of the selected session and start a new session with all details of an existing session copied. All fields are editable.
End a session in the In Progress table.
Delete the session. Deleting a session removes it from the Diagnostics page.
View information on sessions in the History table.
View the individual session in a new tab.
Configure the number of sessions to display or navigate through pages of sessions.
